info.title: Modeus activity-descriptor API
info.description: Contract for the multi-agent activity-descriptor backend (cards 1, 18, 19, 20). This file is the source of truth; the copies served by the API from `api-docs/` (`swagger.json` and `swagger.yaml`, shown at `/swagger/`) are generated from it. All endpoints are relative to the `/api/v1` server and, except for `GET /health`, require a JWT bearer token. Successful responses are JSON; run progress is streamed by `GET /runs/{id}/events` as `text/event-stream`. Error responses carry a stable machine-readable `code` and a human-readable `message`.

get.summary: Expert review queue for disputed evidence
get.description: Returns evidence that still needs expert review: `status=pending` (default) or `status=rejected`. Approved evidence is intentionally never returned. Each row carries run_id, node_id/node_title, source_id/source_title/source_url, ref_id and the quote so an expert can decide without extra lookups. The order is stable (`created_at`, then `id`), so pagination with `limit` (1..200, default 50) and `offset` (>= 0, default 0) is deterministic. An empty page is `[]`, never `null`. Only the expert roles admin, teacher and rop may call this operation; student and guest receive 403.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Review state to list. Any value other than pending or rejected is a 400.

200.description: One page of the review queue; an empty page is [].

put.description: Requires the admin, teacher or rop role. Validates the flat node list and saves it atomically. An existing tree is never replaced; saving again is rejected with 409. Tree writes require the PostgreSQL store.

get.description: Returns the finalized activity tree only when the run status is done.

get.description: `text/event-stream`. Pipeline events are `stage_change`, `error` and `done` with `data` containing `stage`, `status`, `pct` and, when applicable, `message`. Chat runs additionally emit `agent_thinking`, `agent_message` and `run_status` events. Heartbeats are sent as `event: heartbeat`. The client may reconnect with `Last-Event-ID`; previously delivered events are skipped, and the stream closes when the run reaches done or failed.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: ID of the last received event; the server resumes after it without duplicates.

get.summary: Resolved synthesizer conflicts for a run
get.description: Returns title/description conflicts detected and deterministically resolved by the synthesizer during finalization. Every conflict keeps the competing values and the winner (interview > standard > vacancy > document). The list is empty when the run has no stored conflicts.

200.description: Array of resolved conflicts; [] when none were stored.

get.description: Returns agent-memory messages emitted by the deterministic synthesizer during finalization. Messages of kind `conflict` carry the resolved conflict object in `payload`. The list is empty when the run has no stored messages.

get.summary: Diff two snapshots of a run
get.description: Compares the tree stored in the `against` snapshot (base) with the tree stored in the path snapshot (head). Both snapshots must belong to the run `{id}`. Nodes are matched by id; `added` and `removed` list whole nodes and `changed` lists nodes with the changed field names in the fixed order `title`, `description`, `type`, `parent_id`, `evidence`. Evidence order inside a node is not significant, an empty status is treated as `pending`, and every returned node carries its evidence (`source_id`, `ref_id`, `quote`, `status`) so the UI can jump to the original source quote. Equal snapshots produce an empty diff (all arrays empty, summary zeros).

parameters.name: against
parameters.description: Base snapshot id; the path snapshot is the head of the comparison.

200.description: Snapshot tree diff (added, removed, changed and summary counts).
